resources.string: Required to display the pause screen during a call.
Allow auto-start and unrestricted battery use.
For Instant Pause to put your calls on hold, Android must ask you for a special permission.
It is quick, and you can remove it at any time.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s.
Incorrect code (case matters). Attempts left before a timeout: %1$d.
Could not save the code. Check the storage space and try again.
Choose an alphanumeric code (letters + digits). It will be required to disable or delete a window, or to return to these settings.
Enter the current code, then the new one.
Last step before protection: choose your code.
It will be required to cut a window or delete it. Choose it now, while you are calm: it is what will hold up that evening.
At least 6 characters, with at least one letter and one digit. The code is never stored in plain text and cannot be recovered: if you forget it, you will have to clear the app data.
Stop protection from being switched off on impulse.
Write it now, while you are calm. It will appear at the moment of impulse.
This call can wait until tomorrow.
Leave empty to restore the default sentence.
A code is required before using the app.
Locked — the code will be required.
Do it now, while you are calm: this code is what will stop you from cutting everything off tonight.
The code is created at setup and cannot be removed from the app. Only a change (with the old code) is possible.
What the code protects (and does not)
The code is created the first time you open the app: it cannot be skipped or removed afterwards.
Required to: cut a window, delete it (including a running Zen period), or change the code.
Never required to: block a call, add a window, start Zen, read the history.
Unlocking only lasts for the session: 60 s in the background and the code is required again.
Three attempts, then 30 s, 1 min, 2 min… up to 15 min of waiting between attempts.
The code is never stored in plain text: only a PBKDF2 hash (120 000 iterations) is kept on the device.
An allowed contact can always reach you — but not for an hour. Android only lets an app hang up with this permission: without it, you could talk indefinitely.
The countdown starts when the call is answered: 3 minutes of talking, not 3 minutes including ringing.
At 0:00 the line is cut. You start from zero for the next call, as many times as needed.
The permission was permanently denied: Android will not show the request again. Open the app settings to grant it.
The app stays on this screen until the permission is granted.
The pause above the lock screen
Android 14+ no longer grants full-screen display automatically: the pause screen may only appear as a notification. The call is blocked either way — only the way the pause is shown to you changes.
Blocking the call does not depend on this permission.
Without it, tap the notification to open the pause.
This step will not come back. You can change your mind in the app\'s Android settings.
Zen period running, until %1$s. A shorter duration will ask for your code.
Choose your Zen period: tap the number of hours you want. Protection starts immediately.
Shorten the Zen period? Calls would be blocked again at %1$s instead of %2$s. Enter your code to confirm.
Stop Zen mode now? Calls will no longer be blocked until the next window.
Add a window to enable automatic protection (e.g. 10 pm – 7 am).
Disable the %1$s – %2$s window? Without it, nothing will block your calls during that slot.
Crosses midnight: the window starts on the selected day.
No Contacts app on this device.
Unreadable number: it cannot be allowed.
Add an allowed contact? Their calls will go through even during a window.
Remove %1$s from the trust circle? Their calls will be blocked again during windows.
Limit of %1$d contacts reached. Remove a contact to add another.
These contacts are never blocked, even during an active window. %1$d contacts maximum, and an allowed call lasts 3 minutes: it is cut automatically afterwards.
Without an allowed contact, all calls are blocked during windows (except emergencies: 112 and local emergency numbers).
Blocked calls and calls allowed by your trust circle will appear here.
Discreet notification while the pause screen opens
Discreet reminder while the pause screen is displayed
Countdown for calls to the trust circle
Keeps protection active in the background
Tap here to catch your breath.
Tap to open the pause screen and breathe for a moment.
Mutes WhatsApp, Signal and Telegram ringtones during your windows. Emergency calls and alarms remain possible.
Access not granted: Android requires an explicit authorization (Settings › Special app access).
Access removed: sound stays muted until you turn Do Not Disturb off manually.
Do Not Disturb is on while the protection is active.
You turned it off for this window. It will silence the next one again.
Applies to the whole app, notifications included.
Available from Android 13. Before that, the app follows your phone language.
